Name: sonos_media_configured
Help: Whether this API deployment provides the media coordination slice.

Name: sonos_media_coordination_available
Help: Whether the durable media coordination store is available at scrape time.

Name: sonos_media_operations
Help: Retained media operations by bounded execution phase; not a count of device successes.

Name: sonos_collector_enabled
Help: Whether background collection is enabled by configuration.

Name: sonos_collector_heartbeat_max_age_seconds
Help: Allowed heartbeat age including sweep, poll and scheduling budgets.

Name: sonos_collector_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds
Help: Unix time of the latest collector heartbeat.

Name: sonos_collector_sweep_duration_seconds
Help: Duration of the latest completed bounded collection sweep.

Name: sonos_collector_probe_attempts_total
Help: Description probes in this collector generation, including discovery addresses.

Name: sonos_collector_probe_failures_total
Help: Failed description probes, including expected discovery misses.

Name: sonos_collector_probe_timeouts_total
Help: Timed-out description probes in this collector generation.

Name: sonos_discovery_addresses_probed
Help: Unique addresses actually probed during the latest full discovery pass.

Name: sonos_discovery_devices_found
Help: Successful validated description probes during the latest deduplicated discovery pass.

Name: sonos_device_info
Help: Last known readable player metadata; value is 1, not evidence of current reachability.

Name: sonos_wireless_info
Help: Current reported wireless mode and connection metadata; absent when the source is unavailable.

Name: sonos_playback_info
Help: Current reported transport state and status; absent when the source is unavailable.

Name: sonos_device_probe_success
Help: Whether the latest device description probe succeeded.

Name: sonos_device_probe_duration_seconds
Help: Duration of the latest description probe including bounded retries.

Name: sonos_device_monitoring_enabled
Help: Latest confirmed diagnostic scheduling permission; absent if unavailable.

Name: sonos_device_diagnostic_interval_seconds
Help: Effective diagnostic polling interval including the collector floor.

Name: sonos_device_gena_enabled
Help: Whether topology callback collection is enabled.

Name: sonos_device_gena_subscribed
Help: Whether a topology callback lease is currently subscribed.

Name: sonos_device_gena_initial_received
Help: Whether the topology callback initial notification was confirmed.

Name: sonos_device_gena_last_notification_timestamp_seconds
Help: Unix time of the last topology notification, absent before any notification.

Name: sonos_device_volume
Help: Player Master volume on its reported 0 to 100 scale; not acoustic loudness.

Name: sonos_device_muted
Help: Player Master mute state, independent of group mute.

Name: sonos_ethernet_link_up
Help: Reported link state for an Ethernet port; not overall device reachability.

Name: sonos_source_scrape_success
Help: Whether the latest source attempt succeeded.

Name: sonos_source_observation_fresh
Help: Whether the latest source attempt succeeded and its last good observation is current.

Name: sonos_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds
Help: Unix time of the latest successful source observation.

Name: sonos_interface_receive_bytes_total
Help: Raw receive bytes reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_transmit_bytes_total
Help: Raw transmit bytes reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_receive_packets_total
Help: Raw receive packets reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_transmit_packets_total
Help: Raw transmit packets reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_receive_errors_total
Help: Raw receive errors reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_transmit_errors_total
Help: Raw transmit errors reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_receive_dropped_total
Help: Raw receive drops reported by the device interface.

Name: sonos_interface_transmit_dropped_total
Help: Raw transmit drops reported by the device interface.
